title: Harm Threshold
summary: Classifies the decision from GREEN through BLACK according to harm, reversibility, power, and who pays.
mechanism: The most serious applicable condition governs. Later confidence, authority, or preference cannot ratchet a binding floor downward.
failure_modes: Using organizational status as a discount
test_status: The ladder and escalation semantics are specified; thresholds still require domain calibration and independent validation.
next_tests: Test monotonic escalation and prohibited downgrades
